title: Iteration Groups
description: Named iteration groups shared across multiple forEach elements. Each group defines an iteration variable ('as') and a list of values ('in'). Multiple elements referencing the same group expand in parallel — aligned by value.

as.description: The iteration variable name, referenced as ${each.<as>}.

oneOf.description: List of values to iterate over.
A variable reference that resolves to a list (e.g. ${var.regions}).
